comparison.context: 4 opportunities worth 54000.00 USD. Each model column adds up to that total. 9000.00 is Unattributed under every model: no eligible touch, so it is not in Influenced either.
comparison.window: Window: No lookback cap: every touch up to the conversion · Amount: Pipeline (credited at opportunity creation)
comparison.notice: Each column applies one named rule to the same touches. The numbers show association under that rule, not causal impact: no column shows that a campaign caused a deal. A gap between columns is the rules' difference, not a measured lift.
